entities.summary: Differdange Castle is a Renaissance-era château located on a hill in the centre of Differdange in southern Luxembourg. It was built in 1577, although an earlier fortified castle of Differdange dates from around 1310. It has been the campus of Miami University Dolibois European Center since 1997.
